title: deyeuxia scabrescens
intro: Deyeuxia scabrescens, commonly known as Tibetan needle grass, is a type of grass native to the high-altitude regions of the Tibetan Plateau. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Deyeuxia scabrescens are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, that may exert anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral effects. However, more research is needed to fully understand the properties and effects of this plant on human health.
